v16: glimpses - the electric piano that will play the answer lets slip its first notes, growing, through the last epoch
v18: the quench - four bars of almost nothing (the blips alone at half velocity over the hum), then the last epoch builds back a layer a bar
v25: a cello plays the target riff sixteen times slower, as a chorale, while the hottest epoch flails
v27: the drums find a rule first - a Game of Life glider plays snare, clave, cowbell and hat through the second epoch over the kick
v29: the cello from the hottest epoch returns under the found riff, the same line at twice its old speed

v32: the crystal - in the coda last eight bars the found riff is heard at three scales at once: keys at its own speed, a VOSIM bell an octave up at half speed, the cello (16x slower in the hottest epoch, 8x at convergence) now only 4x slower: a mensuration canon, the lattice ringing

v33: the worse road, gladly - every uphill move the hot search accepts (the Metropolis rule the first reading names) is heard in the hottest epoch: a CZ voice slides from the old note to the worse one on that step, a slip, a shrug

v35: parallel tempering - a hotter replica of the search runs beside it through the second epoch on a Karplus-Strong string, wanders off, and twice takes the colder search answer (snapping into unison, once in the bars where the machine listens to itself) before drifting away again

v45 THE HEAT HAS OVERTONES: e1 bars 4-19 one A2 held on risset-arpeggio (Risset's Mutations harmonic arpeggio), its overtones stepping out one by one under the hottest chaos
